history.overview: Hollows East was once a Dragorn mining tunnel, later collapsed and corrupted by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Mining Era
timeline.description: Dragorn miners carved the eastern tunnels for stone extraction.

timeline.name: Muramite Assault
timeline.description: Muramite forces collapsed the tunnel during their invasion.

timeline.name: Discord Rupture
timeline.description: Discord energy cracked open the chamber, creating unstable fissures.

timeline.name: Resistance Ambushes
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels used alcoves to ambush Muramite patrols.
